## Calendar edit history

- Revised for Fall 2026.
- Reorganized the course around an estimand-aware SCM workflow: scientific question → hypothesis/prediction → DAG → identification → estimator → estimate → inference.
- Consolidated graded work into integrated Milestone Assignments.
